answers.answer: Independent Lead review (Claude; AGY wrote the code) of slice B attempt 3, exact 4-path diff 52a075d..5cc46f0, read together with the whole slice B (454beca..5cc46f0). Canonical verification PASS; type-check, lint and the focused unit suite (28 tests) PASS; the Lead reran the full e2e suite at 4c2b70e: 61 passed, 5 skipped (phone cross-device-sync), 0 failed. F-42B-3 is fixed: NotesView consumes ?new=1 once by router.replace, removing only the new key, so the notebooks cache update after the first create (note_count + 1) or any later notebooks refetch can no longer reopen a blank editor; the replace is a same-route query change, so it never triggers the route-leave flush. The new notes.spec.ts regression mounts /notes?new=1, asserts the query is cleared, one createNote, the body kept after the acknowledgement, and the next edit sent as updateNote with base_version 1 (this also closes the missing row_version assertion noted after attempt 2); quick-note.spec.ts now asserts the body value and the cleaned URL after Đã lưu; today.spec.ts follows the new URL. F-42B-1 and F-42B-2 stay fixed (flush awaits the whole in-flight save; a failed flush cancels note, notebook and route switches). Disclosures: the new regressions were not executed against the base code (the base never clears the query, so the query assertion would fail there); a save that keeps failing, for example offline, blocks switching note, notebook or leaving Notes until it succeeds, which follows the owner decision that switching with a pending change saves first and is left to Story 4.3, which owns the non-blocking flush.
